records.command:
set -eu
p=/etc/metrix/codeip-preview/control/authelia-configuration-4183d9355dd3.yml
s=/tmp/opencut-legitate-oidc-review.yml
install -m 600 "$p" "$s"
cat >> "$s" <<'EOF'
      - client_id: opencut-local
        client_name: OpenCut Local
        public: true
        authorization_policy: two_factor
        require_pkce: true
        pkce_challenge_method: S256
        redirect_uris:
          - http://localhost:3000/api/accounts/legitate/callback
          - http://localhost:3211/api/accounts/legitate/callback
        scopes: [openid, profile]
        response_types: [code]
        grant_types: [authorization_code]
        token_endpoint_auth_method: none
EOF
docker cp "$s" metrix-platform-authelia-1:/tmp/opencut-legitate-review.yml
docker exec metrix-platform-authelia-1 /app/authelia config validate --config /tmp/opencut-legitate-review.yml 2>&1 | tail -15
